text:
maya: quick sync 024-03-22 EU change window prep. i'm going to take a full SLO snapshot at 05:50 UTC. who should I include?
kevin: p95 per-route, p99 embed, 5xx rate, kv-cache miss, error-budget burn, streaming tail. also model fallback counts.
nana: add reranker 4xx and any 4xx->5xx conversion rates. saw a small bump yesterday night.
sre-bot: FYI simulated alert: embed-route p95 up ~30% vs baseline (115ms -> 150ms) on eu-west in last 45m. sample trace trace-eu-91a.
maya: do we know if staging had a variant roll?
kevin: quantize-v2 rc3 rolled to staging at 02:40 UTC. no prod change yet.
nana: i'll grab the trace logs: query trace-eu-91a for kernel fallback events and kv latencies.
kevin: logs show kernel fallback on gpu-node-21 and increased KV fetch latencies around the same time. a handful of 502s but mostly tails.
maya: recommendation: pin eu-embed to v2.1.4-rc2 for the change window and delay traffic shift until we validate kernel regressions overnight.
nana: agree. draft release note: "EU change window: hold traffic shift; eu-embed pinned to v2.1.4-rc2 pending runtime kernel regression for rc3 (see RED-4219)."
deploy-bot: recorded pin by @maya -> route=eu-embed, version=v2.1.4-rc2, reason="staging p95 rise with rc3". ticket: https://issues.redwood/RED-4219
sre-bot: running quick smoke on pinned version: sample=2k reqs -> p95=117ms, 5xx=0.06%, kv-miss=2.0% -> smoke OK.
kevin: plan: 1) update release notes & changelog with pin and rollback steps; 2) run kernel regression matrix on rc3 overnight; re-evaluate at 04:30 UTC.
maya: adding rollback/unpin commands in release notes: `deploy-bot pin remove --route eu-embed --version v2.1.4-rc2` and emergency rollback command in runbook.
nana: notify platform-ops and oncall that the EU window is delayed and include the snapshot link.
maya: final: no traffic shift until re-eval at 05:00 UTC. if metrics stable then controlled ramp 10% -> 30% -> 60%. abort if p95 > 1.25x baseline or 5xx > 0.5%.
sre-bot: ramp policy saved to RED-4219. tagging oncall @kevin @ana pls ack and monitor overnight tests. i'll post the final snapshot at 04:30 UTC.
kevin: ack.
nana: ack :thumbsup:
